cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
I don’t have direct access to a reverse‑geocoding service in this environment, so I can’t pull the address for you right now.  
However, you can easily get that information yourself using a public geocoding API. Here are a couple of common options:

| Service | Endpoint | Example Request | Notes |
|---------|----------|-----------------|-------|
| **Google Maps Geocoding API** | `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json` | `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY` | Requires an API key. |
| **OpenStreetMap Nominatim** | `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse` | `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=jsonv2&lat=37.4224764&lon=-122.0842499` | No key required, but you must include a valid `User-Agent` header and respect the usage policy. |
| **OpenCage Geocoder** | `https://api.opencagedata.com/geocode/v1/json` | `https://api.opencagedata.com/geocode/v1/json?q=37.4224764+-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY` | Free tier available. |

### Quick Test with Nominatim

If you just want to try it out quickly, you can paste the following URL into your browser:

```
https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=jsonv2&lat=37.4224764&lon=-122.0842499
```

You’ll receive a JSON response that includes the formatted address, city, state, country, and more.

### Using the Google Maps API (Python Example)

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY"
lat, lon = 37.4224764, -122.0842499
url = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json"

params = {
    "latlng": f"{lat},{lon}",
    "key": API_KEY
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = response.json()

if data["status"] == "OK":
    address = data["results"][0]["formatted_address"]
    print("Address:", address)
else:
    print("Error:", data["status"])
```

Replace `"YOUR_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY"` with your actual key.
